summary.motive: Devastate over-aggressive defenses with the signature Y-Leak constraint: faking a slice block before leaking the H-back vertically into vacated boundary space.
summary.whyItWorks: The split-zone fake pulls the entire front seven and strong safety to the right. X’s deep post route drags the boundary corner inside, leaving the entire left sideline completely abandoned for the leaking H-back.
summary.failureMode: A disciplined backside DE or safety staying in deep boundary discipline and not biting on the run/post action.

beats.title: Condensed Split-Zone Pre-Snap Look
beats.text: Identical 12P condensed wing alignment. Defense expects another heavy dose of inside/split-zone running.

beats.title: Full Zone Stretch & Slice Action
beats.text: Offensive line sells lateral stretch right. H-Back slices across the formation, heading straight for the unblocked backside WDE.

beats.title: The Bluff Block at the Line of Scrimmage
beats.text: H makes subtle bluff contact with WDE at the line of scrimmage to simulate the kickout block, while QB executes a naked bootleg rollout to the left.

beats.title: The Stealth Y-Leak Slip
beats.text: While the entire defense flows right or chases the QB, H slips completely untouched through the line and accelerates vertically up the left sideline.

beats.title: The Throwback Strike for the Touchdown
beats.text: With boundary corner LCB cleared out by X and safety FS pinned inside, QB squares up and throws back across the grain to H for a walk-in explosive score.

relations.tell: H-Back bluffs the kick-out block on backside DE and leaks vertically untouched down the sideline.
